node.title: Re^4: Web Scraping
node.author: betmatt
node.doctext: Python is better at doing analysis or perhaps I should say 'machine learning' 'on the fly'. For example it may be better at following nodes (or leads) through a twitter feed. Python might be able to learn how to find the best pages. Otherwise your probably right, Perl would be faster than Python for most text processing. The regular expression capabilities of Perl, as build in, are better I am sure.
